adjudication.rationale: The diff adds multiple DB fallbacks that load a credential solely by primary key without any ownership/tenant check, then use it to create/update/delete calendar events. In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` inside `createAllCalendarEvents`, if a matching in-memory credential isn’t found it does `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: destination.credentialId } })` and then calls `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)`. Similarly in `updateCalendarEvents` it falls back to `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: reference.credentialId } })` and uses it for `updateEvent(...)`. In `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts`, if the credential isn’t found under `bookingToDelete.user.credentials`, it falls back to `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } })` and uses it for deletions. None of these validate `credential.userId`/`teamId` matches the booking organizer/team, so if `destination.credentialId` / booking reference credentialId can be influenced upstream, this enables cross-tenant token use.
